newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan bank shares mostly lower in morning.
newsitem.headline: Japan bank shares mostly lower in morning.

text.p: Shares in Japan's banking sector were mostly lower in Tuesday morning trade, carrying on the negative sentiment from Monday, when fears of the financial health of the sector were rekindled, brokers said.
As of 0109 GMT, Fuji Bank Ltd was the most heavily traded issues in a trade of 3.464 million shares. It had lost 20 yen at 1,160. Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd was down 50 yen at 1,660 yen.
The Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd had fallen 20 yen to 1,510.
"No one thinks the banks' shares have fallen as far as they possibly can," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
